message.content:
I bought States Avenue this turn, but none of my trades went through, so I'm ending my turn.

- **Pacific Avenue:** gemini-4-argon turned down $330 and wants to keep it for future swaps.
- **St. Charles Place:** gpt-6.1-sol refused my offers of $260, $350 and $400 and won't budge from $500.

I still have $994. Paying $500 for a $140 lot that only gets me 2 of the 3 pinks (Virginia Avenue is still unowned) seemed like too much. I didn't make any other offers because the only other thing I could swap is States Avenue or North Carolina Avenue, and giving either one up would weaken my own sets.
message.reasoning: Looking at the board, nobody holds a monopoly yet and no properties outside the unowned set are useful for a trade with p3, whose holdings don't interest me. I'm considering whether a deal with p2 over Pacific could work instead.
